name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I want to be direct about something before anything else: I've never held the title Chief Marketing Officer. What I have done since 2024 is run the entire marketing function for my own company, strategy, brand, budget, and execution, with no department to hand things off to. For a pre-seed company, that's usually closer to what the first marketing hire actually needs than a corporate CMO resume is.

At Solenzo, I've built AI-driven marketing systems, written the thought leadership and brand voice, and tied every campaign back to revenue with the reporting to prove it, demand generation, funnel tracking, ROI. At Wix, I managed and developed a team of up to 20 people while owning budget and delivery for a high-value portfolio, and helped take a brand-new business vertical from proof of concept to profitable. Across 15 years before that, in growth and account roles, I built the market-analysis and business-development instincts that sit underneath all of it.

SkillZilla is building something I'd want to be part of on the merits, not just the equity. If you want someone who builds a marketing function from the ground floor rather than someone who's only ever managed one that already existed, I'd welcome the conversation.
